title: Mask Control Results (Bach et al. 2013)
html:
Remark. Mask Control Results (Bach et al. 2013)

The movable mask was positioned behind the double-slit and translated from one side to the other. Three regimes were observed:

  1. Single-slit P_1: mask blocks slit 2, only slit 1 open. Single-slit diffraction observed with weak double-slit contribution visible in the negative first order (due to finite mask--slit separation of 230 \mum).

  2. Double-slit P_{12}: mask centered, both slits fully open. Full double-slit diffraction pattern with the central five orders visible. At this position the mask edges are 2500 nm from center, affecting only diffraction orders > 60.

  3. Single-slit P_2: mask blocks slit 1, only slit 2 open. Mirror image of P_1, with weak double-slit contribution in the positive first order.

The key quantum mechanical relation P_{12} \neq P_1 + P_2 was directly verified: the double-slit pattern exhibits interference fringes absent from either single-slit distribution.
